H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky

H1104: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy

H4853: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire
H8269: a head person (of any rank or class)
H2398: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
H3789: to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)
H7239: a myriad, i.e. indefinitely, large number

H6485: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.

H4714: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt

H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H1219: to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
